description: 90° Adjustable Lighting & Solar Panel Head: Flexibly rotate the head up to 90° to optimize solar charging during the day and direct light to desired areas at night, perfect for varied outdoor setups. Dual Lighting Modes for All-Night Illumination: – Mode 1: Low brightness (43.37lm) for 8–10 hours. – Mode 2: High brightness (63.86lm) for 4–6 hours. Switch modes with a simple press of the manual button. Dusk-to-Dawn Operation: Integrated light sensor automatically turns the light off at sunrise and on at dusk, no manual switching required once set. Super Bright White LED Light: Powered by 10 high-intensity LED beads that emit a crisp 6000–6500K daylight white glow, improving outdoor visibility and aesthetics. High-Efficiency Solar Panel: Large surface polycrystalline solar panel provides fast charging, even in partial sun, storing energy efficiently into a 1500mAh lithium iron phosphate battery. Weatherproof & Long-Lasting: Built to withstand the elements with an IP65 waterproof rating, making it ideal for rain, dust, and year-round outdoor use. Simple DIY Installation: Mount easily on outdoor walls with the included screws and fittings, no electrician required. Perfect For: Outdoor landscapes, flower beds, garden paths, patios, fences, walkways, garages, courtyards, and more.
